description: Get your plan, page-quota usage, entitlement flags (size cap, custom slug, password, branding, subdomain, custom domain), and the primary host new links publish on. Call when you need plan limits, domain details or paid-option availability; a basic publish can use defaults without this extra call. The primary host is chosen in the dashboard (manageDomainsUrl), not through this API.
name: get_account

customDomain.description: Whether this plan may point a hostname the user owns at their pages (set it at manageDomainsUrl).

customSubdomain.description: Whether this plan may claim a {name}.dochost.co subdomain (set it at manageDomainsUrl).

manageDomainsUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user adds domains and picks the primary one. Send them here to change it.

primaryHost.description: Host new links publish on: a custom domain, `{sub}.dochost.co`, or `dochost.co/d`.

title: Get my dochost account
